scope: Targeted component research; no purchase, cart, CAD, topology or released-file changes.
decision: Evaluate Adafruit 4432 as the minimum-change USB-C elbow. Direct Micro-B-host to C single cable not qualified by this bounded review.

candidates.dataEvidence: Supplier states every pin connects end-to-end; no active components. Existing Micro-B OTG host cable remains.
candidates.availability: In stock at US Adafruit store on verification date
candidates.nextEvidence: Socket-axis position and seated projection plus actual coupled-4472 clearance. Overall size is not a complete mated assembly.

candidates.kind: Micro-B OTG cable plus Micro-B-female / C-male adapter; secondary incomplete candidate, not a qualified single cable
candidates.microHostEvidence: 3610 explicitly supports Pi Zero OTG and grounds the ID pin at both Micro-B ends.
candidates.diagramFetch: Supplier-linked 3610 diagram returned HTTP404; no substitute dimensions inferred.
candidates.availability: 3610 in stock; 4299 72 listed at US Adafruit store on verification date
candidates.nextEvidence: Cable-end mould dimensions, joined Micro-B/adapter projection, adapter CC termination, and enumerating OpenRB from Pi. More flexible cable length does not prove it can be stowed.

negativeControls.reason: 1060mm cable to connect Micro-B radio to C PC/Android; does not establish Micro-B-host direction and is not a compact selection.
Primary description expressly restricts operation to C host and USB3 Micro-B peripheral; wrong host direction and wrong Micro-B form for Pi Zero.
